df4d45e3-5704-48d9-86a1-db844ae66b57.quote: Thraex marks the last hero Grux basic-attacked, adding damage against that target and reducing that target's damage to Grux. Savage Strikes adds ramping on-hit damage that heals, and Ferocity grows attack speed the longer hero combat lasts. That suits a long brawler, and Grux took the most damage of any ally. Golden Mane is the second-minor alternative, cutting damage from non-area attacks and abilities, trading the attack speed ramp for durability against Sparrow's basic attacks and Feast.
